verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's marketing pages list 'Predictive Segmentation', 'Generative AI features', and 'Actionable insights into audience growth and conversion funnels', suggesting some AI-driven analytics/suggestions exist inside the product, but these are thin pricing-page bullet points with no detailed documentation of how insights are generated or surfaced. Missing for 10: first-party docs explaining the AI insight/suggestion features in depth, independent/hands-on evidence confirming these work as described, and concrete examples of generated insights.
